sections.title: Identity and form
sections.text: The catalogue's Buxus entry represents Buxus sempervirens, common box. This evergreen shrub or small tree can reach about 5 m, with small opposite leaves, inconspicuous pale-yellow axillary flowers in spring and a brown three-valved capsule with black seeds. It is widely planted for hedges and topiary.

sections.title: Toxicity and image
sections.text: All parts can be poisonous; larger ingestions may cause gastrointestinal symptoms in people, and box is harmful to pets. The plate shows leaves, flower clusters and a three-valved capsule, not berries.
